items.title: S&P revises GM outlook to positive on widening margins and cash flow
items.summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings has revised its credit outlook on General Motors Company (NYSE:GM) and subsidiary General Motors Financial Co. Inc. to positive from stable, citing significant margin recovery and expanding cash generation. S&P affirmed its 'BBB' issuer credit ratings on both entities, pointing to a potential upgrade over the next 12 to 24 months.
